name: CHELA-SLAY: Spherical Linearized Attention with Yat-Kernel.
description: CHELA-SLAY: Spherical Linearized Attention with Yat-Kernel.  Implements hybrid linear attention via spherical normalization onto the unit hypersphere combined with trigonometric random Fourier feature mappings (Yat-Kernel) and adaptive gating for smooth distillation from pretrained attention.  Hardened for production across DistilBERT, RoBERTa/BERT, GPT-2, and Qwen/LLaMA architectures: - Robust pr

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
